channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: The day's vulnerability curation reveals a severe concentration of remote code execution, authentication bypasses, and unsafe deserialization attacks targeting web applications, cloud environments, and emerging AI/ML toolchains. Prominent vendors and products including IBM QRadar, Oracle middleware, RustDesk, and Kubernetes management interfaces suffer from critical flaws allowing unauthorized access, container escapes, and full system compromise via memory corruption or logic errors. Additionally, significant risks persist in desktop and IoT sectors, where developers face threats from malicious extensions and reverse engineering suites, while embedded devices remain vulnerable to firmware manipulation and unauthenticated command injection.
